purpose: Define explicit lifecycle states for persisted DWH data while preserving stable semantic identity and separating lifecycle state from storage location and authorization.

topics.name: DWH Data Lifecycle State
topics.purpose: Define explicit lifecycle states for persisted DWH data while preserving stable semantic identity and separating lifecycle state from storage location and authorization.

semantics.identity_rule: Lifecycle transition does not replace the underlying record/resource semantic identity unless a new copy/materialization is explicitly created.
semantics.state_rule: Lifecycle state is explicit machine-readable metadata.
semantics.storage_rule: Storage tier/location is separate from lifecycle state.
semantics.availability_rule: Inactive/archived/expired availability behavior is explicit per profile.
semantics.classification_rule: Lifecycle transition does not implicitly lower classification.
semantics.ownership_rule: Lifecycle transition does not transfer semantic ownership.
semantics.authority_rule: Lifecycle visibility does not grant transition/read/delete authority.

invariants.rule: Retention, archival, expiry, purge and hold state are explicit lifecycle semantics over exact data identities; time passage, storage movement or archive location never silently deletes, declassifies, transfers ownership or restores data.

hard_gates.condition: archive path used as lifecycle identity
time passage silently purges without policy

references.purpose: Storage binding remains separate from lifecycle state.
